A note other notes embed pieces of.

## why a garden

A garden is a website that grows the way notes do: linked, unfinished, revisited.

It isn't a blog. Nothing in it is ever done. ^unfinished

## what to plant

- links between ideas
- pictures of ideas, written as text ^pictures
- things you can poke at

### a nested heading

Embedding `## what to plant` brings this along too, because it sits under it.

## what not to plant

Anything you'd be sad to see change.
